responsibility: Owns the continuity decision that records how an exchange was classified and which objective governs after it.
failure_boundary: fail_closed — the active objective is derived from the latest decision rather than stored as a mutable flag, and a decision referencing an unknown objective or transaction is refused by foreign key
recovery_behavior: The active objective is recomputed from the highest-seq decision on every read, so an interrupted write leaves the previous objective governing rather than leaving no objective at all
replacement_contract: A replacement must record classification, treated_as, prior and active objective, antecedents and disposition, expose a recomputable decision_hash, and derive the active objective rather than storing it twice
evidence_produced: antecedents_json capturing what was retrieved and scored
superseded objective ids retained and queryable
